title: Each type in retirement
caption:
No alarm, no boss, and somehow busier than ever.

One is finally writing the book. One retired on Friday and was chairing the community board by Monday. One is restoring an old car and fixing the whole street's bikes on the side. Swipe to find yourself, or your parents.

Retirement doesn't change your type. It finally gives it time.

Send this to someone who's just retired, or counting the days.
